name: speech
description: Text-to-speech narration. The narrate skill turns a script into narration.wav plus words.json, a start and end time for every word, so a video or page can sync to the voice. The kokoro backend runs Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0) locally through onnxruntime; its word timings come from the model's own per-token durations. espeak-ng, which kokoro needs to read words as phonemes, is GPL-3.0 and installed by you, never by the plugin. A SessionStart hook installs the hash-locked Python packages into the plugin data directory, setup downloads the pinned model files, and check reports each missing prerequisite.
